description:
Play Morris on iPhone and iPad with a clear board, gentle stone movements and room to consider your next move.

Challenge the computer or take turns with another person on the same device. Choose Nine Men’s Morris, Twelve Men’s Morris, Morabaraba or Lasker Morris. Five difficulty levels offer different challenges.

Hints show a suggested move directly on the board. Turn legal targets and last-move markers on or off to suit your preferences. Review the move history or undo a move to reconsider a decision.

Your current game is saved locally. All computer moves are calculated on your device. No account or internet connection is needed to play.

• Four variants and five computer levels
• Two players on the same device
• Visual hints and adjustable playing aids
• Move history and undo
• Portrait and landscape on iPhone and iPad
• English and German interface
• No ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases

Muehlenstein is an independently designed native app using the free Sanmill game engine. Complete source code and license notices are publicly available. Online games are not included.
promotionalText: Four Morris variants, five difficulty levels and visual hints. Play offline against the computer or take turns on one device. No ads or account required.
